examples.label: 四则运算
examples.description: 中缀运算符是源码层的糖，脱糖后 AST 里只有函数调用，乘除先于加减
examples.source: amount * bps / 10000

examples.label: 比较
examples.description: 比较两个数值得到 bool；整数与浮点混合时整数会被安全提升
examples.source: amount > limit

examples.label: 布尔组合
examples.description: &&、|| 与 ! 都是 if 的派生形式，不进注册表，求值保持短路
examples.source: enabled && !blocked

examples.label: 条件选择
examples.description: if 是惰性的：只有被选中的那个分支会求值，两个分支必须同型
examples.source: if(vip, discount, 0)

examples.label: 局部绑定
examples.description: let 给中间结果起名，绑定只在表达式内可见，不会进入契约

examples.label: 值分支
examples.description: switch 带主体时逐个匹配值，分支惰性求值，通常要写 else
examples.source:
switch(country,
  case "SG" => "adyen_sg",
  case "MY" => "stripe_my",
  else "stripe_global"
)

examples.label: 枚举穷尽
examples.description: 契约里的 enum 是命名闭集，成员在表达式里写作 @成员；成员被覆盖完就可以省略 else，契约新增成员会让旧规则编译失败
examples.source:
switch(channel,
  case @adyen  => "primary",
  case @stripe => "backup"
)

args.name: channel
args.doc: 当前渠道，运行边界拒绝集合外的字符串

examples.label: 条件链
examples.description: switch 不写主体就是条件链，替代嵌套 if，按书写顺序命中
examples.source:
switch(
  case amount >= 100000 => "large",
  case amount >= 1000   => "medium",
  else "small"
)

examples.label: 字符串拼接
examples.description: 加号在字符串上是拼接，具体重载由类型推导选出
examples.source: country + ":" + channel

examples.label: 数组字面量
examples.description: 数组元素必须同型，元素可以是任意表达式
examples.source: [base, base * 2, base * 3]

examples.label: 字典字面量
examples.description: 字典的 key 固定是字符串，所有 value 必须同型
examples.source: {"gross": amount, "fee": fee, "net": amount - fee}

examples.label: 列表推导
examples.description: 读作“产出什么 ← 从哪来”，推导式本身是一个表达式，返回新数组
examples.source: [price * 2 for price in prices]

examples.label: 推导式筛选
examples.description: 推导式的 if 子句是筛选条件，可省略；循环变量不会进入契约
examples.source: [price for price in prices if price >= minimum]

examples.label: 折叠求和
examples.description: reduce 把数组折进累加器：元素名、累加器名与初值都写在语法里
examples.source: reduce(price in prices, total = 0, total + price)

examples.label: 聚合函数
examples.description: 求和、计数、最值不用手写折叠：推导式先算出要聚合的东西，再交给 sum / len / max

examples.label: 索引与取余
examples.description: 数组按下标取、字典按键取，越界或缺键是错误而不是空值；% 取余数

result.doc: 首笔、渠道费率与不足一元的零头

examples.description: 契约可以声明 record：字段各有自己的类型，用 order.amount 读，用 {name: 值} 造

examples.label: 报价级联择优
examples.description: 主路是一次宽 fallback 级联，备份池用推导式逐个报价、失败的自动落到挂牌价，reduce 取最低后再与主路比价
examples.source:
let(
  primary = fallback(
    route.fee_quote_v1(status_01, 0.018),
    route.fee_quote_v1(status_02, 0.020),
    route.fee_quote_v1(status_03, 0.022),
    route.fee_quote_v1(status_04, 0.024),
    route.fee_quote_v1(status_05, 0.026),
    listed_fee
  ),
  pool = [fallback(route.fee_quote_v1(pool_status, fee), listed_fee) for fee in pool_fees],
  cheapest = min(pool),
  {
    "primary": primary,
    "pool_best": cheapest,
    "chosen": switch(case cheapest < primary => cheapest, else primary)
  }
)

examples.label: 全球支付决策
examples.description: 合规、风险、渠道、币种、额度各由最合适的结构算成一个局部量，最后一条扁平条件链收口，而不是十层 switch 套娃
examples.source:
let(
  flagged = len([name for name, hit in watchlists if hit]),
  risk = fallback(model.fraud_v1(model.embed_v1(features)), risk_fallback),
  candidates = [name for name, status in channel_statuses if route.is_healthy_v1(status)],
  live = len(candidates),
  settlement = switch(case currency == settlement_currency => "local", else "fx"),
  tier = switch(
    case amount >= high_value_limit => "high",
    case amount <= minimum_amount   => "micro",
    else "standard"
  ),
  needs_3ds = method == "card" && !three_ds_completed && amount > three_ds_limit,
  switch(
    case !enabled            => "disabled",
    case flagged > 0         => "reject:compliance",
    case risk >= risk_reject => "reject:risk",
    case risk >= risk_review => "review:risk",
    case tier == "micro"     => "reject:minimum",
    case tier == "high"      => "review:high_value",
    case live == 0           => "hold:no_channel",
    case needs_3ds           => "challenge:3ds",
    else "route:" + settlement + ":" + capture_mode
  )
)

args.doc: 各合规名单是否命中，key 是名单名

args.name: channel_statuses
args.doc: 渠道健康快照，key 是渠道号

args.name: three_ds_limit
args.doc: 强制 3DS 金额阈值，单位：分

examples.label: 结构化支付编排
examples.description: 模型评分与信号计数先定处置，每个下游阶段只管自己那一件事，最后由一个 if 决定发出放行包还是拦截包
examples.source:
let(
  risk = fallback(model.fraud_v1(model.embed_v1(features)), risk_fallback),
  hits = len([name for name, fired in signals if fired]),
  action = switch(
    case blocked => "reject",
    case risk >= 0.90 => "review",
    case hits >= 2 => "review",
    case amount > review_limit => "review",
    else "approve"
  ),
  route = switch(
    case country == "BR" && method == "bank" => "pix",
    case method == "wallet" => "wallet",
    case route.is_healthy_v1(primary_health) => "adyen",
    else "stripe"
  ),
  auth_mode = switch(
    case method != "card" => "native",
    case amount > three_ds_limit => "three_ds",
    else "frictionless"
  ),
  capture = switch(case risk >= 0.70 => "manual", else "auto"),
  if(action == "approve",
    {"action": action, "route": route, "auth": auth_mode, "capture": capture, "reason": "approved"},
    {"action": action, "route": "none", "auth": "none", "capture": "none",
     "reason": switch(action, case "reject" => "risk_or_blocklist", else "manual_review")}
  )
)

examples.label: 跨境结算流水线
examples.description: reduce 汇总明细，顺序 let 表达十段计算流水线，条件费用由 switch 决定，最后打包成数组字典
examples.source:
let(
  gross = sum(line_items),
  interchange = gross * interchange_bps / 10000,
  scheme_fee = gross * scheme_bps / 10000,
  fx_fee = switch(case cross_border => gross * fx_bps / 10000, else 0),
  gateway_fee = gross * gateway_bps / 10000 + fixed_fee,
  total_fee = interchange + scheme_fee + fx_fee + gateway_fee,
  reserve = gross * reserve_bps / 10000,
  net_before_tax = gross - total_fee - reserve,
  withholding = switch(case taxable => net_before_tax * tax_bps / 10000, else 0),
  payable = net_before_tax - withholding,
  {"fees": [interchange, scheme_fee, fx_fee, gateway_fee, total_fee], "settlement": [gross, reserve, withholding, payable]}
)

examples.label: 费率结算
examples.description: reduce 汇总批次金额，switch 给变动费封顶，局部绑定接着算固定费、准备金和净结算额
examples.source:
let(
  gross = sum(amounts),
  variable_fee = gross * bps / 10000,
  capped_fee = switch(case variable_fee > fee_cap => fee_cap, else variable_fee),
  net = gross - capped_fee - fixed_fee,
  net + reserve
)
